posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
No mention of the Mist Storm in Tactics. Thats really sad. That and Nightmist are absolutly connected and it's sad it's not even touched on. My current guess is that the mists that disapated at the end of the card game storyline somehow re-formed and are spreading through some areas of the world in Tactics, transporting everything it touches to a different dimension (as alluded to in the Tactics story).

Other than that there was a ton of great information this episode and happy that a lot of my questions were asked, even one that was addressed not as Foote but by my first name (I don't think they put that one together so I squeaked that one through). The Nightmist vs Fanatic part was really facinating to me in particular.

posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
Foote:

That and Nightmist are absolutly connected and it's sad it's not even touched on.

Two possible reasons that they didn't mention that:

  1. That's a reveal that they want to keep up their sleeve for a later date. That could be a very big plot point, and sharing it now might ruin the story.

  2. Nightmist and that event have no connection whatsoever.

Foote:

The Nightmist vs Fanatic part was really facinating to me in particular.

That's a comics trope that was used quite often. "You are a super being and I don't know you, so that means we have to fight!"

Honestly I'm surprised we haven't heard of any other situations where two heroes have come to blows on their first comic encounter. I'm really hoping that there is an episode dedicated to 'Sentinel Comics' in general, I have so many questions I want to ask about it's history…

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked: We already knew a fair bit about the Freedom Five, and the Prime Wardens, too.  I would agree that Dark Watch, as a team, has received the smallest amount of attention thus far--there's been very little in the way of comics, promo cards, etc. to build out their backstory.  Heck, they're the only heroes that have only their original character card and a "member of a team" promo card.  All the Freedom Five (including Unity) and all the Prime Wardens have at least 2 promo cards each.
